## CURRENT / 2026-10-17 / WEB_10 — official tunnel-client v0.0.16 exact-tag source-only preflight (COORDINATOR RESEARCH)

**SCOPE / NO NEW CODE OR EXECUTION:** ChatGPT WEB_10 independently read upstream source at the **official annotated v0.0.16 tag** of `openai/tunnel-client`, which resolves to Git commit `5f99daabd4aa4a77049e6d81d54a0d8c18335397`. GitHub release metadata identifies asset `tunnel-client-runtime-source-v0.0.16.tar.gz` (239841 bytes; published SHA-256 `88953678325ffe650cc562bbd0b147e7e8e984b0527aa8b1647b02d6660ce9e0`). The release archive itself was **NOT downloaded or hashed in the coordinator runtime**, and source→installed EXE correspondence is **NOT independently attested**; matching CLI commit literal is only a useful lead.

**BOUNDED SOURCE OBSERVATIONS:** `pkg/runtimeconfig/proxy.go` validates explicit proxy URLs as **HTTP(S) only** (SOCKS scheme rejected by parser). `pkg/runtimeconfig/config.go` supplies global `--http-proxy` to control-plane, MCP and Harpoon with component/binding overrides to inspect. `pkg/transport/proxy.go` clones `http.Transport` and installs a fixed proxy callback for nonnil explicit proxy, bypassing `HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY` for that HTTP path; when explicit proxy is missing, default transport/environment behavior may permit direct networking. `pkg/controlplane/internal/tunnel_service_client.go` applies configured proxy to both standard and secret-client transports; `pkg/mcpclient/fxmodule.go` applies proxy to streamable MCP HTTP transport and then may override dial for configured Unix socket. These are **source-branch observations**, not a complete reachability or executable trace. `pkg/cloudflared/runtime/supervisor.go` conditionally launches a separate `cloudflared` process when token/managed mode enables it (`pkg/runtimeconfig/config.go: Enabled()`); its network path is **not covered** by the Go HTTP `--http-proxy` callback and needs independent gating if enabled. For WUA STDIO-first evaluation, propose leaving Cloudflared/optional outbound transports disabled unless separately proven; do not treat this as an approved production configuration.

**OPEN / NOT VERIFIED:** HTTP CONNECT acceptance of the real 10808 sing-box SOCKS5 listener, its loaded remote outbound and DNS routing, all config/override/redirect/resolver edges, full native dependency and child egress, fail-closed under faults, exact source-to-EXE build attestation, 18 blocked native test contracts, hosted tunnel and 0/4 ordinary Chat MCP calls. Nothing was executed locally, network changed or activated. `HOSTED_TUNNEL_ON_HOLD_BY_USER` stays mandatory. **NEXT PROPOSAL:** controlled offline source transfer from official release to Codex, verify actual archive digest/contents against tag, perform complete version-pinned source audit, then separately approve native process isolation before running EXE. Codex must not fetch GitHub without express user authorization. LLM12 shared runtime and WA4-R remain untouched.

---

This is not 30/30 independent SHA coverage or independent Windows execution. The report's pre-publication `LOCAL ONLY` language is historical after user publication.

**FINDINGS:** Codex locally reported parser-unit **5/5 PASS** (not native transport), evidence matrix **17 PASS / 5 BLOCKED / 4 NOT RUN** (26 evidence rows, not network tests), protective input hash claims 70/70 unchanged (not independently rehashed from live Windows files), and **0** actual Go tunnel-client processes/tests in AM06. **STOP CONDITIONS UNCHANGED:** `SOURCE AUDIT PARTIAL`, `NATIVE OFFLINE TEST NOT VERIFIED`, `REAL CLIENT FAIL-CLOSED NOT VERIFIED`, `V2RAY REMOTE ROUTE NOT VERIFIED`, `HOSTED TUNNEL ON HOLD`, ordinary ChatGPT MCP E2E **0/4 NOT VERIFIED**. The current Windows machine did not provide demonstrably enforced native/child non-loopback containment; loopback flags or Python hooks are insufficient. No permission to change firewall, V2Ray, proxy, DNS, OS features, other MCP plugins or production, or to activate hosted tunnel.

**NEXT / PROPOSAL ONLY:** supply exact official v0.0.16 runtime-source archive through user/ChatGPT-authorized channel with verified release digest (source already readable independently via pinned GitHub tag), review full config/transport/fallback graph without execution, and separately agree an enforceable disposable Windows native egress boundary before actual offline transport fault tests.
